route_title: Asymmetric Thickness Reinitialization from Round-7 Optimum with 0.5x Step Size
compilation_rationale: Bounded route overrides topological count to exactly 12 finite alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 layers between air and fused silica. Initial thicknesses are shifted by plus or minus 8 nm per index and clamped to 20-350 nm. Four mean-transmittance objectives target the specified pass and stop bands. Gradient optimizer uses half nominal learning rate.
